title: [Core] Duplicate Lesson - Lesson Detail - Duration prefilled value does not show required validation
description: Exact LT-107960 regression - Duplicate individual lesson from Lesson Detail should save when Duration is already populated.
preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- Enable Duration Field on Lesson Form is enabled.
- Individual lesson LES-107960-01 exists with Start Time 06:40, End Time 07:40, and Duration 60.
steps_actions:
1. "Open lesson detail for LES-107960-01."
2. "Click Duplicate / Duplicate individual lesson."
3. "Observe Duration (minutes)."
4. "Fill any remaining required fields without clearing Duration and click Save."
5. "Confirm the duplicated lesson."
steps_result:
1. "Lesson detail opens."
2. "Duplicate Lesson form opens."
3. "Duration is populated with 60."
4. "No Complete this field. message appears under Duration."
5. "Duplicate lesson is saved successfully with Duration 60."
steps_data:
1. "source_lesson = LES-107960-01"
2. "entry_point = Lesson Detail"
3. "start = 06:40; end = 07:40; duration = 60"
4. "forbidden_error = Complete this field."
5. "expected_duration = 60"

title: [Core] Duplicate Lesson - Calendar popup - Duration prefilled value saves successfully

preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce Calendar.
- Enable Duration Field on Lesson Form is enabled.
- Individual lesson LES-107960-02 appears on Calendar with Start Time 06:40, End Time 07:40, and Duration 60.
steps_actions:
1. "Open Calendar and click lesson LES-107960-02."
2. "Click Duplicate from the Calendar lesson popup/detail drawer."
3. "Observe Duration (minutes)."
4. "Save the duplicate without editing Duration."
5. "Refresh Calendar."
steps_result:
1. "Lesson popup/detail drawer opens."
2. "Duplicate Lesson form opens from Calendar."
3. "Duration is populated with 60."
4. "No required validation appears under Duration; save succeeds."
5. "The duplicated lesson appears at the selected date/time."
steps_data:
1. "source_lesson = LES-107960-02"
2. "entry_point = Calendar"
3. "expected_duration = 60"
4. "forbidden_error = Complete this field."
5. "expected = duplicate_card_visible"

title: [Core] Lesson forms - Extend Recurrence and drag/drop derived Duration do not trigger required validation

preconditions:
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce.
- Enable Duration Field on Lesson Form is enabled.
- Recurring lesson schedule LS-107960-04 exists with Start Time 09:00, End Time 10:00, Duration 60.
- A draggable lesson LES-107960-04 exists on Calendar.
steps_actions:
1. "Open LS-107960-04 and click Extend Recurrence."
2. "Observe Duration and save a valid extension."
3. "Drag LES-107960-04 to a valid new time slot on Calendar."

steps_result:

2. "Duration is populated; no Complete this field. appears; extension saves."
